page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Right margin holds two notes, one beside the lines "fuetudine ... ufus feudorum" and one beside "frequentia delictorum". Running head at top. Signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.l: de moribus quod de sola bono-

marginalia.note: l.2. tit. 26 in fin. de Usibus feud.

page.notes: Printed "fure" in the line "fure fiat latro" is clear. "conjunctò", "effracturâ" and "frequentiâ" carry a tilde or stroke over the vowel as printed; the mark is not fully clear at this resolution. "Abigeis" is broken across lines ("A-" / "bigeis") and is written here as one word with the printed hyphen. The signature "I 6" and catchword "le," at the foot are partly obscured and not certain. The note "l.2. tit." is printed in three short lines and is joined here.
